events.title: Astro public beta released
events.summary: Fred Schott and contributors released Astro's first public beta on June 8, 2021 — a static site builder that ships zero JavaScript by default with partial hydration.
events.about: Astro's island architecture lets developers use React, Vue, or Svelte components but only hydrate interactive islands — dramatically cutting page weight. It became the default choice for content-heavy sites prioritizing Core Web Vitals.

narrative.whyChosen: Astro pioneered partial hydration for content-focused sites.
narrative.whyImportant: Ship less JavaScript became a mainstream performance strategy.
narrative.problemSolved: Static site generators shipped entire framework runtimes even for mostly static pages.
